cases.problem: A sealed electronics enclosure dissipates 42 W continuously in 35 C ambient. Internal component temperature must remain below 85 C without a fan.
A centrifugal pump intermittently cavitates after process temperature rises while required flow remains constant.
A lightweight sensor bracket cracks near its mounting holes after repeated machine vibration. Mass increase must stay below 8 percent.
Design a passive containment concept for a small battery module while minimizing mass and preventing a single-cell thermal event from directly heating adjacent cells.
A water filtration stage must double contaminant capture capacity without increasing clean-filter pressure drop by more than 15 percent.
